title: Plan
description: plans/{planId}.json in R2 PRIVATE — §52, §53, Etapa 8b + Etapa 10. SuperAdmin-managed plan catalog entry. No public projection exists for this object (§53 'gerenciar planos' is an admin-only concern; billing/Asaas itself is modules/financial/, still unbuilt). monthlyPrice/setupPrice/maxActiveListings/modules were added in Etapa 10 (§52) — all optional so a plan created before that lot (including the seeded "free" default) still validates.

planId.description: Slug-shaped id, e.g. "free", "premium". Immutable once created.

monthlyPrice.description: Recurring monthly price in BRL (same integer-cents-free convention as listing.price, core/validation.js#isPrice). Optional — a plan without one defaults to 0 (business/plans.js#createPlan).

setupPrice.description: One-time setup/implantação fee in BRL, charged once when the broker joins the plan (not enforced/charged by any code yet — modules/financial/ is still a placeholder). Optional, defaults to 0.

maxGalleryItems.description: Replaces the old PROVISIONAL_MAX_GALLERY_ITEMS fixed constant (business/listings.js, Etapa 5) — the per-listing gallery photo cap enforced for every broker on this plan.

maxActiveListings.description: Cap on the broker's active listing count. `null` (or omitted) means unlimited — reverses the 'fora de escopo' call from Etapa 8b (docs/CHANGELOG.md). Resolved by business/plans.js#getActiveListingLimitForBroker but NOT enforced anywhere yet (no caller in business/listings.js) — wiring it into listing creation is a pendência, confirmation needed first.

modules.description: Per-plan feature toggles (§52) — business/plans.js#PLAN_MODULE_KEYS is the closed list of valid keys. Queried through modules/plans/eligibility.js; not yet consulted by modules/publications or modules/feeds (pendência, confirmation needed before wiring). Optional, defaults to {} (nothing enabled).
